protocols.description: List of protocol:user_id strings to import. Supported prefixes are 'lp:' for Launchpad and 'gh:' for GitHub. If empty, the system default (Launchpad) is used when invoked without arguments, but this file effectively configures the default behavior or can be read by scripts. Note: ssh-import-id reads this file to determine the default source if no args are provided, or can be used in automation. The manpage states 'ssh-import-id will read a URL variable string from /etc/ssh/ssh_import_id'. We parametrize the content of this file.
